evidence: Tier 3 (source review): every literal in tests/mrm.rs is transcribed from the two pinned class tests; no C++ was built or executed, and no retained C++ output exists for these headers. Class-test section accounting: MRMFeature_test.cpp 16 sections, 16 ported, 0 mapped-with-evidence, 0 unaccounted; MRMTransitionGroup_test.cpp 28 sections, 28 ported, 0 mapped-with-evidence, 0 unaccounted. The four NOT_TESTABLE sections of MRMFeature_test.cpp and the five of MRMTransitionGroup_test.cpp are ported as real tests rather than mapped. The C++ subsetDependent section calls subset; it is ported against subset, exactly as written, and subset_dependent is covered separately by native tests. The transition type is native (SimpleTransition), because ReactionMonitoringTransition is not ported; the class tests' setLibraryIntensity and setNativeID calls map onto its fields one for one. Everything the port checks that the source does not — duplicate-key rejection, the unknown-key error paths the source leaves to OPENMS_PRECONDITION, the ceilings, and isInternallyConsistent actually returning false — is tier 4 (Rust-only invariants), derived from the anchored source lines above.
